vb_textbox.text: Pick a gnome and stick with that Gnome. The game tries to get you to switch gnomes by starting to offer you smaller and smaller numbers of mushrooms; however, I believe the best option is to stay with either the left or the right gnome throughout. Whenever I switched, the alternative gnome did not often offer me a higher number of mushrooms. I think there may be something within the game relating to the hats of the gnomes, e.g. size of hat = more/less mushrooms. But, I couldn't work out the actual pattern during my 200 goes. Good luck!
